description: findu-spring-security: provider activation state machine + 4 validations with history/versioning, biometric re-validation endpoint, support approve/reject, profile exposure of activation state + flags (login NOT blocked), and event dispatch (confirmation email after OTP; provider-facing PROVEEDOR_ACTIVADO/PROVEEDOR_RECHAZADO notifications; support ticket via help-v2). Depends at runtime on FEAT-002 (help-v2 externalRef ticket) and FEAT-003 (templates) but compiles/tests independently with mocked ports. Covers plan.md items 1-5.
steps: Schema/authz (plan item 1): add additive idempotent DDL to SECURITY/findu-spring-security/src/main/resources/schema.sql (ALTER "user" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS estado_activacion/soporte_notified/soporte_ticket_code; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS provider_activation_validation + provider_biometric_capture with the columns/index/CHECK(face_match_score 0..1) from design 3.2; NO new DROP). Create scripts/migrations/V2__provider_activation.sql with the same additive DDL + operations 18-21 via OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE ... ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING + setval realignment + rol_operation grants (4->18,19; 5->20,21) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING + re-apply add_soporte.sql content idempotently. Append ops 18-21 (static literal paths, module_id=3, permite_all=FALSE, id comments) + grants to data.sql in its plain-INSERT style.

Domain/persistence (plan item 2): add domain/model/ProviderActivation + enums ProviderActivationState/ValidationType/ValidationState; infrastructure/entity ProviderActivationValidationEntity + ProviderBiometricCaptureEntity (Lombok @Table/@Column); add estadoActivacion/soporteNotified/soporteTicketCode to UserEntity + Usuario; R2DBC repos ProviderActivationValidationRepository (@Query for current row by user_id,tipo,is_current) + ProviderBiometricCaptureRepository; application/port/output/persistence/ProviderActivationRepositoryPort + adapter under infrastructure/adapter/persistence.

External ports/util (plan item 3): add application/port/output/externalapi/CorePerfilPort (fetch provider profile by authUserId -> id,nombreCompleto,fechaNacimiento,urlImagenPerfil; best-effort PUT photo by perfilId) + SupportTicketPort (create ticket userId,userRole=PROVEEDOR,subject,description,externalRef=ACT-{userId} -> ticketCode) with WebClient adapters using gateway base URLs (new config props, keep qa sql.init.mode:never); add PROVEEDOR_ACTIVADO/PROVEEDOR_RECHAZADO to util/NotificationTemplates; add util/TextNormalizer (NFD strip + lowercase + whitespace collapse).

Use cases (plan item 4): ActivationProgressService.recompute (fire support ticket once when otp_ok&&email_ok&&biometria_ok && !soporte_notified; set soporte_notified+ticket_code on 2xx; advance EN_REVISION_SOPORTE; help-v2 5xx leaves flag false + logs ERROR; idempotent). SubmitBiometricUseCase (resolve authed user like VerifyPhoneOtpUseCaseImpl.resolveAuthenticatedUser; CorePerfilPort fetch, 409 perfil_core_requerido if missing; accent-insensitive name compare via TextNormalizer; LocalDate.isEqual birthdate; trust client faceMatched; business rejections -> 200 {biometriaOk:false,motivo}; malformed -> 400 per design 5.3 table; on pass insert OK capture, set biometria_ok, write-once foto_frontal_url, best-effort non-fatal core photo PUT using PerfilProveedorDetalleResponse.id; recompute). GetActivationStatusUseCase. ApproveProviderUseCase/RejectProviderUseCase (precondition EN_REVISION_SOPORTE else 409; ACTIVADO/RECHAZADO; reject resets soporte_notified=false; dispatch PROVEEDOR_ACTIVADO/PROVEEDOR_RECHAZADO to recipient=PROVEEDOR_{userId} via NotificationPort). Modify VerifyPhoneOtpUseCaseImpl (mark otp_ok + compose sendEmailVerificationUseCase.sendVerificationForUser(saved).onErrorResume(...) into the save->delete->thenReturn chain). Modify VerifyEmailUseCaseImpl (mark email_ok + recompute). Add infrastructure/scheduler retry for pending support tickets + pending core photo sync (RevokedTokenRedisEvictionScheduler style).

Controller/DTO/profile (plan item 5): presentation/controller/ProviderActivationController base /api/v1/activation with POST /biometric, GET /status, POST /approve (body {userId}), POST /reject (body {userId,motivo}) — all STATIC paths; DTOs BiometricSubmitRequest/ActivationStatusResponse/ApproveProviderRequest/RejectProviderRequest with design 5.3 validation; extend UserProfileResponse with estadoActivacion/otpOk/emailOk/biometriaOk/soporteOk/fotoPerfilFrontalUrl and populate in JwtManagerImpl.getCurrentUserProfile; do NOT touch auth/login config (Usuario.isEnabled returns active).

Add StepVerifier/Mockito unit tests: recompute transitions + fire-once guard, biometric business-rejection vs 400, TextNormalizer equality, approve/reject state guards (mock CorePerfilPort/SupportTicketPort/NotificationPort/repos).
acceptance_criteria: cd SECURITY/findu-spring-security && .\gradlew.bat build completes with no errors.
schema.sql and V2__provider_activation.sql are additive/idempotent (no new DROP of existing tables; ALTER/CREATE IF NOT EXISTS; ops inserted with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING + setval realignment).
Login path unchanged: no edits to isEnabled/isAccountNonLocked or authentication/authorization filters.
Approve/reject endpoints use static literal paths; userId travels in the request body.
verification: Eyeball schema.sql/data.sql/V2 migration for FK order + identity-sequence realignment against existing conventions.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED (all 5 plan items + unit tests), committed on feature/provider-activation (commit 'feat(security): provider activation state machine, biometric re-validation, support approve/reject, profile exposure + event dispatch (FEAT-001)').

WHAT WAS BUILT (SECURITY/findu-spring-security only):
- Step1 Schema/authz: additive idempotent block appended to schema.sql (ALTER "user" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS estado_activacion/soporte_notified/soporte_ticket_code; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS provider_activation_validation + provider_biometric_capture with ix_pav_user_tipo_current index and CHECK(face_match_score 0..1); NO new DROP). New scripts/migrations/V2__provider_activation.sql with the same additive DDL + ops 18-21 via OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE ... ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING + setval realignment + re-applied add_soporte.sql seed (role 5 + soporte user) + grants (4->18,19; 5->20,21) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. data.sql: ops 18-21 appended in plain-INSERT style + role-4 grants (18,19). spring.sql.init.mode left untouched (qa stays 'never').
  DEVIATION FROM DESIGN (documented, FK-safety): design 3.2.1 said data.sql should also grant role 5 -> 20,21, but role 5 (ROLE_OUR_SOPORTE) is seeded ONLY in add_soporte.sql, not in data.sql; adding a role-5 rol_operation row to data.sql would FK-violate on the dev fresh-boot (dev profile runs schema.sql+data.sql every start with sql.init.mode=always). So role-5 approve/reject grants (20,21) live in add_soporte.sql (idempotent, after ops exist) and in V2 migration. data.sql keeps only role-4 grants. Behavior identical once add_soporte.sql/V2 is applied; just correct FK ordering.
- Step2 Domain/persistence: domain/model ProviderActivation + ProviderActivationState/ValidationType/ValidationState enums; entities ProviderActivationValidationEntity + ProviderBiometricCaptureEntity (Lombok @Table/@Column); estadoActivacion/soporteNotified/soporteTicketCode added to UserEntity + Usuario + UsuarioRepoAdapter save mapping (MapStruct auto-maps the domain fields); R2DBC repos ProviderActivationValidationRepository (@Query current-by-user/tipo, markPreviousNotCurrent @Modifying) + ProviderBiometricCaptureRepository (findLatestOkWithPhoto); port ProviderActivationRepositoryPort + ProviderActivationRepoAdapter (composes aggregate; emailOk sourced from user.email_verified OR EMAIL row).
- Step3 External ports/util: CorePerfilPort (+CorePerfilWebClientAdapter: GET perfil/auth/{authUserId} -> empty on 404; best-effort PUT photo) + SupportTicketPort (+SupportTicketWebClientAdapter: POST help/tickets userRole=PROVEEDOR, externalRef=ACT-{userId}, returns ticketCode, propagates error). New config props findu.activation.core.* / help.* / retry-interval-ms in application.yml (gateway base URLs; qa init mode untouched). util.TextNormalizer (NFD strip + lowercase + whitespace collapse). NotificationTemplates += PROVEEDOR_ACTIVADO/PROVEEDOR_RECHAZADO.
- Step4 Use cases: ActivationProgressService(.Impl) recompute fires support ticket once when otp&&email&&bio && !soporte_notified, sets soporte_notified+ticket_code and EN_REVISION_SOPORTE on 2xx, leaves flag false + logs ERROR on help-v2 failure (idempotent). SubmitBiometricUseCase(.Impl): resolves authed user via new AuthenticatedUserResolver, CorePerfilPort fetch (409 perfil_core_requerido if missing), accent-insensitive name compare (TextNormalizer), LocalDate.isEqual birthdate, trusts client faceMatched; business rejections -> 200 {biometriaOk:false,motivo nombre/fecha/rostro_no_coincide}; malformed/future date -> 400; on pass inserts OK capture (write-once foto_frontal_url), marks BIOMETRIA OK, best-effort non-fatal core photo PUT using PerfilProveedorDetalleResponse.id, then recompute. GetActivationStatusUseCase(.Impl). Approve/RejectProviderUseCase(.Impl): precondition EN_REVISION_SOPORTE else 409 (404 if not found); ACTIVADO/RECHAZADO; reject resets soporte_notified=false; dispatch PROVEEDOR_ACTIVADO/PROVEEDOR_RECHAZADO recipient=PROVEEDOR_{userId} via NotificationPort (non-fatal). VerifyPhoneOtpUseCaseImpl: markOtpOk + composed sendEmailVerificationUseCase.sendVerificationForUser(saved).onErrorResume into the save->delete->thenReturn chain. VerifyEmailUseCaseImpl: markEmailOk + recompute (non-fatal). infrastructure/scheduler/ProviderActivationRetryScheduler (RevokedTokenRedisEvictionScheduler style) retries pending support tickets + core photo re-push.
- Step5 Controller/DTO/profile: ProviderActivationController base /api/v1/activation with POST /biometric, GET /status, POST /approve (body {userId}), POST /reject (body {userId,motivo}) -- all STATIC paths; DTOs BiometricSubmitRequest/ActivationStatusResponse/ApproveProviderRequest/RejectProviderRequest with jakarta validation per design 5.3; UserProfileResponse extended with estadoActivacion/otpOk/emailOk/biometriaOk/soporteOk/fotoPerfilFrontalUrl, populated in JwtManagerImpl.getCurrentUserProfile (non-fatal activation load). NO edits to isEnabled/isAccountNonLocked or any auth/login/authorization filter config -- login path unchanged.
- Step6 Tests (StepVerifier/Mockito): TextNormalizerTest, ProviderActivationTest, ActivationProgressServiceImplTest (fire-once guard, 5xx-leaves-flag-false, missing-validation, already-activated no-op), SubmitBiometricUseCaseImplTest (400 malformed/future, 409 perfil missing, business rejections vs 200 pass+photo+recompute), Approve/Reject/GetStatus/AuthenticatedUserResolver tests. Updated existing tests broken by constructor/record changes: VerifyPhoneOtpUseCaseImplTest, VerifyEmailUseCaseImplTest, JwtManagerImplTest, ProfileControllerTest.
